todayOrders.tone_tag: Art. I §8: Delegated Tariff & Commerce Execution
todayOrders.snippet: My Administration is committed to cutting waste in Federal Government spending and identifying opportunities to promote efficient and effective spending.

todayOrders.title: Executive Order 13518—Employment of Veterans in the Federal Government
todayOrders.snippet: Veterans have served and sacrificed in defense of our Nation. When they complete their service, we must do everything in our power to assist them in re-entering civilian life and finding employment.

todayOrders.tone_tag: Art. II §1: Executive Discretion & Internal Operations
todayOrders.snippet: I hereby create a board of three members, to be appointed by me, to investigate this dispute. No member of the board shall be pecuniarily or otherwise interested in any organization of railroad employees or any carrier.

todayOrders.tone_tag: Art. II §1: Executive Discretion & Internal Operations

milestones.description: Harry S. Truman desegregating the United States Armed Forces, establishing equality of treatment and opportunity.

order.title: Executive Order 9981—Establishing the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services
order.snippet: It is hereby declared to be the policy of the President that there shall be equality of treatment and opportunity for all persons in the armed services without regard to race, color, religion or national origin.
